parameters.name: dbt_cloud_conn_id
parameters.description: The connection ID for connecting to dbt Cloud.

parameters.name: run_id
parameters.description: The ID of a dbt Cloud job run.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file path related to the artifact file. Paths are rooted at the target/ directory. Use "manifest.json", "catalog.json", or "run_results.json" to download dbt-generated artifacts for the run.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional. The ID of a dbt Cloud account.

parameters.name: step
parameters.description: Optional. The index of the Step in the Run to query for artifacts. The first step in the run has the index 1. If the step parameter is omitted, artifacts for the last step in the run will be returned.

parameters.name: output_file_name
parameters.description: Optional. The desired file name for the download artifact file. Defaults to <run_id>_<path> (e.g. "728368_run_results.json").

parameters.name: hook_params
parameters.description: Extra arguments passed to the DbtCloudHook constructor.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional. If an account ID is not provided explicitly, the account ID from the dbt Cloud connection will be used.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Optional. The ID of a dbt Cloud project.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: Optional. Field to order the result by. Use '-' to indicate reverse order. For example, to use reverse order by the run ID use ``order_by=-id``.

parameters.name: hook_params
parameters.description: Extra arguments passed to the DbtCloudHook constructor.

parameters.name: dbt_cloud_conn_id
parameters.description: The connection ID for connecting to dbt Cloud.

parameters.name: job_id
parameters.description: The ID of a dbt Cloud job. Required if project_name, environment_name, and job_name are not provided.

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Optional. The name of a dbt Cloud project. Used only if ``job_id`` is None.

parameters.name: environment_name
parameters.description: Optional. The name of a dbt Cloud environment. Used only if ``job_id`` is None.

parameters.name: job_name
parameters.description: Optional. The name of a dbt Cloud job. Used only if ``job_id`` is None.

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: Optional. The ID of a dbt Cloud account.

parameters.name: trigger_reason
parameters.description: Optional. Description of the reason to trigger the job. Defaults to "Triggered via Apache Airflow by task <task_id> in the <dag_id> DAG."

parameters.name: steps_override
parameters.description: Optional. List of dbt commands to execute when triggering the job instead of those configured in dbt Cloud.

parameters.name: schema_override
parameters.description: Optional. Override the destination schema in the configured target for this job.

parameters.name: wait_for_termination
parameters.description: Flag to wait on a job run's termination. By default, this feature is enabled but could be disabled to perform an asynchronous wait for a long-running job run execution using the ``DbtCloudJobRunSensor``.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Time in seconds to wait for a job run to reach a terminal status for non-asynchronous waits. Used only if ``wait_for_termination`` is True. Defaults to 7 days.

parameters.name: check_interval
parameters.description: Time in seconds to check on a job run's status for non-asynchronous waits. Used only if ``wait_for_termination`` is True. Defaults to 60 seconds.

parameters.name: additional_run_config
parameters.description: Optional. Any additional parameters that should be included in the API request when triggering the job.

parameters.name: reuse_existing_run
parameters.description: Flag to determine whether to reuse existing non terminal job run. If set to true and non terminal job runs found, it use the latest run without triggering a new job run.

parameters.name: retry_from_failure
parameters.description: Flag to determine whether to retry the job run from failure. If set to true and the last job run has failed, it triggers a new job run with the same configuration as the failed run. For more information on retry logic, see: https://docs.getdbt.com/dbt-cloud/api-v2#/operations/Retry%20Failed%20Job

parameters.name: deferrable
parameters.description: Run operator in the deferrable mode

parameters.name: hook_params
parameters.description: Extra arguments passed to the DbtCloudHook constructor.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: the API method to be called

parameters.name: http_conn_id
parameters.description: :ref:`http connection<howto/connection:http>` that has the base API url i.e https://www.google.com/ and optional authentication credentials. Default headers can also be specified in the Extra field in json format.

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: The auth type for the service

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive
parameters.description: Enable TCP Keep Alive for the connection.

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_idle
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive Idle parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPIDLE``).

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_count
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive count parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPCNT``)

parameters.name: tcp_keep_alive_interval
parameters.description: The TCP Keep Alive interval parameter (corresponds to ``socket.TCP_KEEPINTVL``)

parameters.name: adapter
parameters.description: An optional instance of `requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter` to mount for the session.

parameters.name: dbt_cloud_conn_id
parameters.description: The ID of the :ref:`dbt Cloud connection <howto/connection:dbt-cloud>`.

parameters.name: timeout_seconds
parameters.description: Optional. The timeout in seconds for HTTP requests. If not provided, no timeout is applied.

parameters.name: retry_limit
parameters.description: The number of times to retry a request in case of failure.

parameters.name: retry_delay
parameters.description: The delay in seconds between retries.

parameters.name: retry_args
parameters.description: A dictionary of arguments to pass to the `tenacity.retry` decorator.

parameters.description: The connection identifier for connecting to dbt Cloud.

parameters.description: The dbt Cloud account identifier.
